note: Parses NUL-separated words from fuzzer input into argv array; each word is strdup'd into heap memory
Sets opt_pin to point to the argv string for --pin option; opt_pin points to heap-allocated argv[i]
Calls change_pin() when --change-pin option is provided
pincode points to the argv string for --pin; if --pin is provided with an empty string, pincode points to an empty heap-allocated string
Checks if pincode is non-NULL and has zero length; true when --pin is set to an empty string

Frees pincode which points to argv[i] (the --pin argument string); this is the invalid-free because the string is still referenced by argv and will be freed again by free_arguments(), causing a double-free/invalid-free crash
Returns error code 2 after the invalid free; ASAN detects the invalid free at this point
